verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an official JavaScript SDK and a full API reference (HTTP API, Pixel API, Transformations/Libraries API) for programmatic building, plus an official MCP server enabling AI agents to interact with the platform via natural language. However, the evidence pack shows only the JS SDK explicitly (no other language SDKs cited) and probes show no OpenAPI/swagger spec is published, which would aid AI-native/agentic tooling. Missing for 10: evidence of the broader multi-language SDK suite (server-side, mobile SDKs), and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec.
